entities.summary: Kera Sherwood-O'Regan is a Māori woman from the South Island of New Zealand concerned with climate change and indigenous rights. She is a disability advocate. At COP25 she told the delegates to "Stop taking up space with your false solutions and get out of our way". In 2023 she became one of that year's BBC 100 Women.
